notes: Full Grand Prix configuration uses the Southern Loop and the complete northern western and eastern technical sections. The operator identifies its full 7.3 km configuration and connecting course roads. Paddock, pit, karting and the northern short-loop closing straight are excluded. Native satellite ground resolution is 10 m. Nearest-neighbor rendering does not add resolution. Fine corner alignment and historical direction remain draft; no vertices are fitted to private diagrams, timing positions or nominal distance. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 7303.6 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

Approximate playback follows midpoints reconstructed from the unchanged supplemental borders. An October 1, 2026 Sentinel-2 scene confirms the complete road footprint and selected connectors; native 10 m pixels do not verify fine edge positions or road widths. The mapped source trace, timing and original border coordinates remain intact. Curbs are illustrative, raster elevations estimated and banking unknown.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 79 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use midpoints of outward inner-boundary normals intersecting the outer boundary; the source trace is preserved, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
